summary: GSI Technology filed an 8-K covering two routine items: (1) its Taiwan subsidiary extended a three-year factory lease in Chu-Pei City through August 2029 at monthly rent of NT$605,640 (~US$19,015), a material agreement but standard operational contract; and (2) results of the August 20, 2026 annual meeting, including election of five directors, ratification of BDO USA as auditor, and a non-binding say-on-pay vote. No special-situation event—no M&A, tender, restructuring, or activist activity. The filing is a routine current report combining a lease renewal and customary shareholder vote disclosures.
